title: Microsoft Edge: simplified energy saver with new defaults and one mode
notes: claim 44: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the existing policy guidance omits version restrictions and gives the wrong minimum Edge version for EfficiencyModeEnabled. The page also asserts that existing policies do not govern the simplified feature, although their future relationship is not documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans new defaults and different setting options for energy saver in Microsoft Edge.
claims.quote: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options.

claims.claim: Energy saver was formerly known as efficiency mode.

claims.claim: The planned simplified energy saver has two enabling conditions: low battery or unplugged.
claims.quote: The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged.

claims.claim: No Learn policy page, Group Policy path or registry/API setting for BatterySaverModeAvailability is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'BatterySaverModeAvailability' and 'BatterySaverModeAvailability Edge simplified energy saver policy registry mapping EfficiencyMode'; read both existing policy pages and policy-index search excerpts. The expected batterysavermodeavailability policy URL returns HTTP 404.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the simplified energy saver feature.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Edge simplified energy saver EfficiencyMode mapping' and 'BatterySaverModeAvailability'; read EfficiencyMode, EfficiencyModeEnabled, and Edge policy-index excerpts. Results describe existing modes, not the roadmap's simplified feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how existing EfficiencyMode and EfficiencyModeEnabled policies map or relate to BatterySaverModeAvailability.
claims.quote: Searched: 'BatterySaverModeAvailability Edge simplified energy saver policy registry mapping EfficiencyMode' and 'Microsoft Edge simplified energy saver EfficiencyMode mapping'; read EfficiencyMode and EfficiencyModeEnabled. Neither documents a relationship to the new policy.

claims.claim: The existing policy pages do not confirm whether these policies govern the planned simplified feature.
claims.quote: Searched: 'BatterySaverModeAvailability' and 'Microsoft Edge simplified energy saver EfficiencyMode mapping'; opened both cited policy references. They describe the existing modes and do not address the planned simplified mode or BatterySaverModeAvailability.
